speaker: Doctor
text: Welcome to the clinic, I am Dr. Agent. To help you with your acute diarrhea, could you please tell me when your symptoms started and if you have had any fever or blood in your stool?

speaker: Patient
text: 58-year-old female. The patient has been treated for community-acquired pneumonia with levofloxacin on the medical floor. She reports developing watery diarrhea with at least 9 episodes within the last two days, accompanied by lower abdominal discomfort and cramping.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Antibiotic-associated diarrhea (likely Clostridioides difficile infection). Given your recent treatment with levofloxacin for pneumonia, I suspect this is the cause. I am requesting stool testing for C. difficile toxin immediately. REQUEST TEST: C.diff_toxigenetic_testing
